system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In May 2026, Anucha entered an instalment agreement for a 240,000 baht debt payable in 24 instalments of 10,000 baht each. He defaulted on instalment 5 only; all other instalments were paid on time. On what amount may the creditor claim default interest? Answer briefly, stating the amount with a one-sentence reason.
raw_response:
The creditor may claim default interest on **10,000 baht only** (the amount of instalment 5).

**Reason:** Under Section 215 of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, when a debtor defaults on one instalment in an instalment contract, the creditor may claim default interest only on the overdue instalment amount, not on the entire remaining debt, unless the contract provides that default on one instalment accelerates the entire obligation (which would require the creditor to declare the entire debt due).
